premises.text: Existing remote formats fail to reproduce event socialization alongside content
premises.evidence_span: People can learn from great content, but they can't socialize

premises.text: Virtual venue with controllable avatars enables moving and talking among many attendees
premises.evidence_span: You can move around and actually talk to people, just like you're going to plan on doing today

premises.text: Organizations with geographically dispersed members can assemble everyone in one Teo room
premises.evidence_span: Those alumni span across 50 countries, and he has no way to bring them into the same room

premises.text: After formal programming, attendees stay to socialize for hours like a real event
premises.evidence_span: for the next few hours, people actually socialize

premises.text: Organizations pay monthly for venues and share ticket and virtual sponsorship revenue
premises.evidence_span: we also take a percentage of ticket sales and virtual sponsorship

value.text: Virtual events that recreate in-person content plus socialization benefits

causal_links.evidence_span: Creating connections that you could never create otherwise
The way that we make money as a company is by charging organizations a monthly fee
